relationships.subject: TLR4
relationships.evidence_quote: TLR4 knockout attenuated morphine-induced tolerance and inhibited the chronic morphine-induced increase in NLRP3 and phosphorylation of TAK1

relationships.subject: TAK1
relationships.evidence_quote: showed decreased development of morphine tolerance and inhibition on repeated morphine-induced increase of NLRP3 but not TLR4

relationships.subject: NLRP3
relationships.evidence_quote: NLRP3 knockout mice showed resistance to morphine-induced analgesic tolerance

key_findings: Microglial TLR4 regulates TAK1 phosphorylation leading to NLRP3 activation in morphine tolerance
TLR4, TAK1 or NLRP3 deficiency/inhibition attenuates chronic morphine antinociceptive tolerance
